what_it_supplies: that the Kimball House at 1801 South Prairie Avenue was designed by Solon S. Beman for the founder of the Kimball Piano Company, and that it is one of the few residences of the avenue still standing when the survey was made
what_it_does_not_supply: A CONSTRUCTION DATE. This record was opened specifically to date the house and it carries no `Building/structure dates` note and no date in its significance statement.
any position, footprint or dimension; nothing is traced from it
note: THIS RECORD IS COMMITTED BECAUSE OF WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY. The Kimball House is the one Prairie Avenue landmark whose commonly repeated construction dates (1890-1892) would fall OUTSIDE the 1880s window T-0473 asks a scene date to sit in, so it is the reading that would have decided the ticket if it existed. It does not exist in this record: HABS IL-1077 dates the house nowhere. The 1890-1892 figure is therefore NOT asserted anywhere in this project, and data/terrain/1880s_scene_date_constraints.json carries this source as a reading that supplies no constraint, so that the next run does not repeat the retrieval and reach for a number off the open web instead. A ticket wanting the Kimball House in an 1880s scene has to date it from a source that states a date.
